oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Hypophosphatasia
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Mornet, Etienne
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: Review
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Hypophosphatasia is a rare inherited disorder characterized by defective bone and teeth mineralization, and deficiency of serum and bone alkaline phosphatase activity. The prevalence of severe forms of the disease has been estimated at 1/100 000.
